svg.title: Figure 8-6: intergenerational income mobility
svg.desc: Two stacked bars. Of children whose parents were in the bottom income fifth, just over 33 percent stayed in the bottom fifth as adults and almost 66 percent moved up. Of children whose parents were in the top fifth, 37 percent stayed in the top fifth and over 60 percent moved down. Both ends show strong stickiness, yet most people moved.

text.font-family: Noto Sans, Segoe UI, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: FIGURE 8-6: WHERE DID CHILDREN OF THE BOTTOM AND TOP FIFTHS END UP?
